Hi Sophie —

Thanks for sending the draft DPA and the UK addendum. I reviewed the doc and attached a current subprocessor matrix (CSV) so you can see our active processors and where processing happens. A few quick notes / asks so we can scope the TIA / DTIA correctly: 

- SCCs: our standard DPA references the EU SCCs by incorporation; the UK addendum we provided is intended to operate alongside the SCCs where applicable. Can you confirm whether your procurement team needs an explicit UK IDTA signature (we can support either DocuSign or signed PDF) or if relying on the addendum is sufficient?

- TIAs/DTIAs: we treat TIA scope as a combination of technical controls + subprocessors. For your EU/UK patients we typically offer an EU-hosted option (single-region) and can provide the TIA evidence snapshot (SOC2 + KMS attestation). Which of the following is your preference: 1) EU-hosted only for production, 2) EU-hosted for production + backup in US with contractual safeguards, or 3) no change to your default multi-region routing?

- Subprocessors: please see the attached matrix. One item to flag: CloudOps Ltd appears in the matrix and does maintenance in the us-east-1 region for some telemetry pipelines. If that is a blocker, we can propose a contract-level restriction or a technical routing exception for your tenancy.

- Evidence: I can assemble a TIA evidence pack (SOC2 excerpts + KMS usage summary + dataflow diagrams). Please let me know which artifacts you need for security review and your expected evidence format (PDF bundle vs shared Drive link).

I'll leave the detailed redlines to our legal team, but wanted to capture these scope items now so we can avoid rework. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Thanks for flagging. Quick answers and proposed artifacts below.

1) UK IDTA signature: Legal Ops can generate the IDTA signature page and put it into DocuSign. Estimated ops lead time: 7 business days after contract signature. Note: if they want CMK (customer-managed keys) we need their KMS endpoint and we’ll coordinate a short onboarding (approx 5 business days).

   - Telemetry streams are pseudonymized and scrubbed before export;
   - CloudOps is in our SOC2 scope under the Infrastructure control domain;
   - We maintain a subprocessor agreement with CloudOps.

Attached artifacts we can produce for Aurelia: 
- SOC2 excerpt (Infrastructure & Availability controls)

- Short routing diagram (PDF) showing EU-only tenancy and backup constraints
